description: This file defines CLI commands for managing compliance export jobs in the Mattermost server, including listing, showing, canceling, downloading, and creating export jobs, with detailed handling of date ranges and job parameters.

methods.name: complianceExportListCmdF
methods.description: Lists compliance export jobs by invoking a generic job list function with specific parameters.

methods.name: complianceExportShowCmdF
methods.description: Retrieves and displays details of a specific compliance export job by ID.

methods.name: complianceExportCancelCmdF
methods.description: Cancels a compliance export job by ID.

methods.name: complianceExportDownloadCmdF
methods.description: Downloads a compliance export file, handling optional output path and renaming based on server suggestions.

methods.name: complianceExportCreateCmdF
methods.description: Creates a new compliance export job with specified type and date range parameters.

methods.name: getStartAndEnd
methods.description: Parses date string or start/end timestamps to determine the job's time range in Unix milliseconds.
